about: Model verdicts on source against tree for ada (system/rag/semcheck.py).

findings.problem: The list items of paragraph 2.1 (Section 2A to Section 2E) are read as headings, so paragraph 2.2, which belongs to General, is placed under the heading Section 2E.
findings.evidence: source: "2.2 Section 2A gives general rules" under "General" / tree: heading_path "... > General > Section 2E > Paragraph 2.2"

findings.problem: A separate paragraph printed after item e of 2C3 is joined into item e.
findings.evidence: source: new paragraph "BS EN 1996-1-1:2005 with its UK National Annex gives design strengths for walls" / tree: "e. ... Tables 6 and 7. BS EN 1996-1-1:2005 with its UK National Annex gives"

findings.problem: The words printed inside the Diagram 3 flow chart are not in labels; only the description carries them.
findings.evidence: source: "Are conditions relating to the building satisfied?" "NO" "Outside scope of this part" "YES" / tree labels: "See para 2C5"

findings.problem: The area limits printed inside Diagram 5 are not in labels; they appear only in the model-written description.
findings.evidence: source: "a. Structural walls on all sides" "Area not exceeding 70m2" "b. Structural walls on three sides" "Area not exceeding 36m2" / tree labels: "See para 2C14"

findings.problem: One heading printed on two lines is split into two headings, and the paragraphs below it sit under the second half only.
findings.evidence: source: "Construction materials and workmanship" / tree: "Construction materials and" and "workmanship"

findings.problem: In Table 4 the words "Distributed loads" belong to the Loading cell of the Roof row, but the grid makes them a heading row in the Element column above all rows.
findings.evidence: source: Roof | "Distributed loads 1.00kN/m² for spans not exceeding 12m" / tree: ["Distributed loads", ""] as heading row

findings.problem: The labels of Diagram 5 leave out the words and area limits printed inside the picture; they are kept only in the model description.
findings.evidence: source: "a. Structural walls on all sides" "Area not exceeding 70m2" "b. Structural walls on three sides" "Area not exceeding 36m2" / tree labels: "See para 2C14"

findings.problem: Diagram 5 belongs to paragraph 2C14 and is printed above the heading, but the tree puts it under 'Construction materials and workmanship'.
findings.evidence: source: "See para 2C14" / tree: "Construction materials and workmanship > Maximum floor area enclosed by structural walls"

findings.problem: The description gives the 140mm or 215mm thickness rule only for walls below ground floor level where Hf exceeds 1m, but the three storey drawing also applies it to a lowest storey wall with no Hf condition.
findings.evidence: source (c. Three storeys): "This wall to be at least 140mm thick blockwork or 215mm thick brickwork" / tree: "Walls below ground floor level are to be at least 140mm thick in blockwork or 215mm in brickwork if Hf exceeds 1m"

findings.problem: The words and the four notes printed inside Diagram 9 are not in labels; they are kept only as a summary in the description, and note 1 is left out.
findings.evidence: source: "1 If Hs is not greater than 2.7m, the compressive strength of bricks or blocks should be used in walls as indicated by the key." / tree labels: "See para 2C21"

findings.problem: The description gives the minimum wall thickness only for walls below ground floor level when Hf exceeds 1m, but the three storey picture also sets it for a ground storey internal wall with no Hf condition.
findings.evidence: source: "This wall to be at least 140mm thick blockwork or 215mm thick brickwork" / tree: "Walls below ground floor level are to be at least 140mm thick in blockwork or 215mm in brickwork if Hf exceeds 1m"

findings.problem: The labels leave out all words inside the picture, including the key, the wall thickness limits and the four printed notes; these are kept only as a summary in the model description.
findings.evidence: source: "Hf Less than or equal to 1m, Condition A" "2 If Hs is greater than 2.7m, the compressive strength" / tree labels: "See para 2C21"

findings.problem: Diagram 10 belongs to paragraph 2C23 under 'Loading on walls' and is printed above the 'End restraint' heading, but the tree puts it under 'End restraint'.
findings.evidence: source: "See para 2C23" / tree: "End restraint > Maximum span of floors"

findings.problem: The labels of Diagram 10 leave out the words printed inside the picture, including the span limit; they are kept only in the model description.
findings.evidence: source: "Floor span maximum 6m" "Centre line of bearing" "Wall" "Floor" / tree labels: "See para 2C23"

findings.problem: Diagram 10 labels hold only the paragraph reference; the words printed in the picture, including the 6m limit, are only in the model description (the limit is also in paragraph 2C23).
findings.evidence: source: "Floor span maximum 6m", "Centre line of bearing", "a. Floor member bearing on wall", "b. Floor member bearing on joist hanger" / tree labels: "See para 2C23"

findings.problem: Diagram 10 is placed under the heading End restraint, but it is printed beside Loading on walls and belongs to paragraph 2C23.
findings.evidence: tree: "End restraint > Maximum span of floors" / source: "Diagram 10 Maximum span of floors" "See para 2C23"

findings.problem: Diagram 14 notes 1 to 7, which give the opening and pier rules, are not in the labels; only note 8 is kept as printed and the rest survive only as a model summary.
findings.evidence: source: "2 W1, W2 or W3 should not exceed 3m", "7 P5 should be greater than or equal to W4/X but should not be less than 665mm" / tree labels: "8 Take the value of the Factor X from Table 8"

findings.problem: Words printed inside Diagram 14, including the height limit, are not in the labels.
findings.evidence: source: "H should not be greater than 2.1 m", "L = length of wall", "corner of two external walls", "Outer face of return wall"

findings.problem: In Table 10 rows V and VI the note that spans the 40 to 70 kN columns is put only in the 40 column and the 50, 60 and 70 columns are left empty.
findings.evidence: source: "Note: Foundations on soil types V and VI do not fall within the provisions of this section if the total load exceeds 30kN/m." / tree: "", "", ""

findings.problem: Paragraph 5.3 holds only the word Definitions; the two definitions printed under it (nominal length of load-bearing wall, key elements) are separate sections beside it, not under 5.3, so a reader sent to paragraph 5.3 finds no definition.
findings.evidence: source: "5.3 Definitions" then "Nominal length of load-bearing wall" ... "Key elements" / tree: para 5.3 text "Definitions"; heading_path "Section 5: ... > Nominal length of load-bearing wall"

findings.problem: Table 11 is placed under the heading Nominal length of load-bearing wall, but it is a table for the whole section (used by paragraph 5.1a).
findings.evidence: tree: "Nominal length of load-bearing wall > Building consequence classes" / source: "Table 11 Building consequence classes"

findings.problem: The heading Key elements lost its capital letter.
findings.evidence: source: "Key elements" / tree: "key elements"

findings.problem: The heading "Timber sizes for floor joists" is not a heading in the tree; the heading and its question and answer are run into one text block under "Frequently Asked Questions" together with the copyright imprint and the contents list.
findings.evidence: source: "Timber sizes for floor joists" (heading) / tree: "ISBN: 978-1-4098-4803-5 Timber sizes for floor joists 4 How do I go about applying ... 5 3 Where can I obtain the timber sizes"

findings.problem: In the basement answer the page number 4 is run into the sentence, and the text jumps straight to words that are not on this page, so the sentence does not read on.
findings.evidence: source: "Planning and Building Control offices" (page ends, then page number 4) / tree: "Planning and Building Control offices 4 dwellings’ on basement design and construction"

findings.problem: The start of condition 2 is lost, so the tree no longer says that Local Authority Building Control must be content.
findings.evidence: source: "2. Local Authority Building Control are content with respect to all the relevant parts of the Building Regulations." / tree: "has been granted 5 Building Regulations."

findings.problem: Page numbers 5 and 6 are run into the body text.
findings.evidence: tree: "Planning Permission has been granted 5 Building Regulations." and "not exempt from the Building Regulations. 6"
